I greatly worry students will see these as black and white answers, which may put them at harm. If they get an error saying that they are disadvantaged due to stress when it’s an error, they may have a self-fulfilling prophecy ahead. If it doesn’t show the stress level or a very stressed student, the distress may be hidden until it’s too late, and before any accommodations could be arranged. Making them more hesitant to get help from human professionals in fear their problems may also be dismissed, when actually a human may be more likely to discern the issue. 

And it may guide the screening tool into the direction the student thinks is most useful to them, for whichever reason.
